title: integration update_client_identity
description: Hub -> integration push session only. The device was renamed, its owner label, remote access or guest expiry changed. The integration updates the HA user (name, local_only). When local_only changes, or a guest expiry is no longer covered by the token lifetime, it rotates the token (new token delivered via POST /api/integration/client-token, old token removed after the acknowledgement; HA closes open sessions of the removed token, so the app re-authenticates under the new rules). Carries the full identity (not a diff), so applying it twice is harmless. The same state is also visible in GET /api/integration/status clients[], which the integration reconciles on every poll.
